description: Publish an order you built with xl_build_order and signed (EIP-712 typed data, free, no gas) to the OwlGate book on X Layer: pass the order object from the post step and your signature. OwlGate checks the signature, funds and approval before it goes live. Returns the order hash (use it with xl_cancel).

order.description: body.order from the xl_build_order post step

name: xl_post_order
title: Publish a Signed X Layer Order
